title: Basic Single-Source Approval Threshold Contradiction
description: Tests discovery of contradictory VP approval thresholds ($50,000 vs $25,000) defined within different sections of the same standard operating procedure, where Section 2.1 permits team manager authorization up to $50,000 without VP approval while Section 4.3 mandates VP sign-off above $25,000.

expectedRequirements.statementPattern: .*up to and including \$50,000 may be authorized.*without Department Vice President approval.*

expectedFindings.rationale: Section 2.1 permits purchase orders up to $50,000 to be authorized without Department Vice President approval, whereas Section 4.3 mandates Vice President sign-off for any order greater than $25,000, creating mutually exclusive approval rules for transactions between $25,000 and $50,000.
